target_customer: Engineering teams in regulated industries such as fintech, healthtech and insurtech that need production-like test data without exposing real PII
problem: Developers need realistic data in staging and test environments, but copying production data is a privacy and compliance risk.
business_model: Open-source core (MIT) with a hosted commercial offering
product_category: Data anonymization and synthetic data orchestration

founders.name: Evis Drenova
founders.background_notes: Later a staff product manager at Grow Therapy after the acquisition.

technical_complexity.rationale: Referentially consistent anonymization across relational databases and orchestration of data sync is standard but fiddly engineering.

defensibility.rationale: An MIT-licensed open source tool is easy to fork and funded commercial rivals such as Tonic existed.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Competitors continued independently; Neosync was bought in September 2025 by Grow Therapy, a mental health company, to use its anonymization technology.

market_need_then: Regulated teams needed safe test data; no quantified demand evidence found for 2022.

branding.domain_note: Used neosync.dev; the fetch returned 404 in 2026 after the acquisition.
branding.community_and_virality: Official GitHub repo reported at roughly 4,000 stars by trackers; Hacker News and Product Hunt launches exist.

brand_strength.rationale: Reasonable open source awareness with about 4,000 GitHub stars but little brand press.

outcome_analysis: Neosync built a small open source data anonymization project that reached about 4,000 GitHub stars and a few named enterprise customers, then was bought by Grow Therapy in September 2025 for its anonymization capability, with the founder joining as a product manager. Price and funding are not public, and the shutdown of its own site suggests an absorbed product, so its commercial scale is unclear.
notes: Unverified funding: aggregators (VCBacked, StartupIntros) list a 500K pre-seed or seed with Y Combinator, Soma Capital and Derrick Li; not recorded as a round. Acquisition source is a press release repost on Pulse 2.0 citing a Grow Therapy release of 2025-09-25; one cross-check from Privsource. YC page lists founding year 2023 versus batch Summer 2022. neosync.dev returned 404. No dated 2022 competitor sources found; results were undated directory pages. Completeness pass: the $500k September 2022 round rests on databases only (Startupintros, VCBacked). Other entries conflict: Bouncewatch dates a round January 2023 with more investors and a TechCrunch-hosted profile shows $2.1M raised as of 2025-01-01; neither is recorded. A second co-founder (Nick Zelei) appears in a search summary without a named source, so he is not added.
